title: Hush Farms
kicker: Glowing blue moss grows over fruits and vegetables.
hook: Glowing blue moss grows over fruits and vegetables.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Hush farms glow low under canopy-shadow, blue moss catching on tools, boots, and the undersides of leaves.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Blue moss glows low across the rows, catching on boot-soles and the undersides of leaves until the whole field hums faint and green. Raised beds run between channels of black water. Little gates click as someone decides which field drinks tonight. The tools...
